VP-001.notes: First therapy specifically for RP11. Positive Phase 1/2 results with vision improvements (LLVA, microperimetry) in 18 patients across 4 dose levels (3, 10, 30, 75 μg). 30μg identified as minimum effective dose. RPD designation makes it eligible for Priority Review Voucher (PRV) worth $100M+ if approved. FDA alignment meeting confirmed trial design for Phase 2/3. However, registrational trial start delayed significantly to by CY2030 (previously 2025-H2). $653M capital raise in Feb 2026 secures funding through 2030. DINGO extension study ongoing for select patients.

recent_updates.event: NYRVANA Phase 1/2試験で初患者投与（2025年10月）。進行したRP患者の休眠錐体細胞を再活性化し、視力と色覚を回復する遺伝子非特異的治療。硝子体内AAV注射、単回投与。ベルギーで開始、フランス・アイルランドに拡大予定。2026年に米国での試験許可取得を目指す。オープンラベル、多施設、用量漸増試験。6ヶ月評価+5年長期フォローアップ

SPVN20.notes: SparingVision's second gene therapy program (after SPVN06). Gene-agnostic intravitreal AAV therapy designed to restore cone vision in advanced RP by reactivating dormant cone photoreceptors using GIRK channel gene. NYRVANA Phase 1/2 first-in-human trial: open-label, multicenter, dose-escalation study. Dose-escalation ongoing in Belgium, France, Ireland. US IND filing planned 2026. Initial safety data expected H2 2026. 6-month evaluation + 5-year long-term follow-up.

Ultevursen.notes: Targets Usher syndrome type 2A and RP with USH2A exon 13 mutations. Antisense oligonucleotide (AON) injected intravitreally to mask disease mutation in RNA via exon skipping. 2-year double-masked, randomized, sham-controlled trial (NCT06627179) with 81 participants ages 8+. Dosing schedule: 4 IVT injections over 2 years (day 0, month 6, 12, 18). ~16,000 affected patients estimated in Western world. Data readout expected H2 2026 to 2027. Developed by Sepul Bio (Théa subsidiary, acquired from ProQR 2023).

ZM-02.status: PRISM trial officially started - Enrolling in US and China

recent_updates.event: PRISM試験が2026年2月25日に正式開始（ClinicalTrials.gov登録）。前向き・無作為化・シャム対照・用量漸増試験。米中複数施設で実施。成人および小児が対象。評価項目: 安全性、MLMT（多輝度移動テスト）、形状識別。主要完了2029年12月、全体完了2031年12月予定。色覚回復能力が他の光遺伝学療法との差別化要因
MOON試験（初ヒト試験）の詳細データ: 36週時点で83%の患者にBCVA ≥0.3 LogMAR改善、平均0.59 LogMAR改善。多輝度移動テストで低照度ナビゲーション能力回復。色覚回復も確認。52週時点で持続性を確認。薬物関連SAEなし、DLTなし。PRISM試験（NCT07282457）: 多施設ランダム化シャム対照用量漸増Phase 1/2、米中両国で実施
FDA cleared IND application for ZM-02, enabling multinational Phase 1/2 PRISM trial
Received FDA Orphan Drug Designation

ZM-02.notes: Gene-agnostic optogenetic therapy using AAV to deliver PsCatCh2.0e channelrhodopsin to retinal ganglion/bipolar cells. Unique ability to restore color vision (unlike other optogenetic approaches). MOON trial (first-in-human, China): 83% BCVA improvement at 36 weeks, mean 0.59 LogMAR gain, durability at 52 weeks, no SAEs. PRISM trial officially started Feb 25, 2026: prospective randomized sham-controlled dose-escalation in US and China. Primary completion Dec 2029, full completion Dec 2031.

message_design.patient_summary: 光遺伝学で視覚再建を狙う。色覚回復の探索もあるが、根治ではない。

jCells.status: JC02-88 trial ongoing - Q1 interim results pending, ARVO 2026 (May) expected

recent_updates.event: Frontiers in Cellular Neuroscience誌に「Retinal progenitor cells (jCell) for retinitis pigmentosa」の査読論文が掲載（PubMed ID: 40927136）。Nature誌にも「First-in-class cell therapy shows promise in patients with progressive vision loss」の記事掲載。JC02-88中間結果はQ1 2026予定だが正式発表は未確認。ARVO 2026（5月）での発表が有力

JC02-88試験のデータ集積・解析中。正式な中間解析プレスリリースは未発行（Q1 2026目標）。ARVO 2026（2026年5月）での発表が有力視。Phase 2b試験での高用量群（300万細胞）で平均+16.27文字改善の既存データを基に、Phase 3ピボタル試験の設計・準備を並行して進行中。Frontiers in Cellular Neuroscience誌で高用量群12ヶ月データ（平均+9.0文字改善）を発表済み
JC02-88 Phase 2試験進行中。2026年Q1に中間結果予定。主要評価項目: ETDRS 15文字以上の視力改善。880万細胞の単回硝子体内注射（従来最高用量の約50%増）。最大60名（18-60歳、遺伝子型不問）。全患者UCアーバイン・ガビンハーバート眼科研究所で治療。シャム群は延長試験で治療を受ける資格あり
First patients treated in JC02-88 trial
JC02-88 Phase 2 trial officially started

jCells.notes: Cell-based therapy (famzeletcel) for RP regardless of causative gene mutation. RMAT designation granted. Previous Phase 2b: high-dose group +16.27 letters, published in Frontiers in Cellular Neuroscience (12-month: +9.0 letters). JC02-88 tests higher dose (8.8M cells) in sham-controlled design. Primary endpoint: ≥15 ETDRS letter improvement. Data expected at ARVO 2026 (May). Phase 3 pivotal trial design and preparation underway.

DSP-3077.company: Sumitomo Pharma America / Sumitomo Pharma / RACTHERA
DSP-3077.status: Phase 1/2 recruiting - FDA Orphan Drug Designation granted

recent_updates.event: FDA Orphan Drug Designation取得（2026-03-23）。DSP-3077は他家iPS細胞由来3D網膜オルガノイド/網膜シートで、米Phase 1/2（NCT06891885）は2026-06-11確認時点でRECRUITING。
FDA Orphan Drug Designation取得（2026年3月23日発表）。オーファン指定により臨床試験費用の税額控除、FDAユーザーフィー免除、承認後7年間の市場独占権が付与。住友ファーマとしては過去1年で4件目のFDA Orphan Drug Designation取得。Phase 1/2試験（NCT06891885）進行中
recent_updates.source: Company PR (prnewswire.com), Foundation Fighting Blindness, CheckOrphan, Ophthalmology Times

recent_updates.event: 住友ファーマR&D説明会（2026年2月17日）: 米国Phase 1/2試験（NCT06891885）進行中。FY2025内（2026年3月末まで）の第1症例移植開始を目標。MEEでの観察研究（NCT06517940）が2026年2月末に完了、エンドポイント最適化に活用。移植後最大15年間の長期安全性モニタリングを計画。神戸アイセンターでは「ひも状」iPS網膜細胞移植の新臨床研究が2025年12月に厚労省承認
他家iPS細胞由来網膜シート（DSP-3077）の米国Phase 1/2試験IND承認。Massachusetts Eye and Earと協力。2020年開始の神戸アイセンター病院での臨床研究では移植後2年間の生着・安全性確認済み。新鮮（非凍結）3D組織/オルガノイドを使用。2025年度中の患者移植開始を目指す

DSP-3077.notes: Allogeneic iPSC-derived 3D retinal organoid/retinal sheet therapy for RP. FDA Orphan Drug Designation was announced on 2026-03-23. NCT06891885 was RECRUITING on ClinicalTrials.gov when checked on 2026-06-11. Sumitomo Pharma America states that DSP-3077 development uses RACTHERA technologies and expertise.

primary_sources.label: Sumitomo Pharma America FDA Orphan Drug Designation PR (2026-03-23)

RTx-015.status: ENVISION Phase 1 trial - dose escalation in progress

recent_updates.event: FDA RMAT指定取得（2026年4月1日発表）。既存のFast Track指定と合わせ2つの加速審査経路を同時取得。RMAT指定により開発中のFDAとの集中的な協議・審査段階でのPriority Review適格性が付与。ENVISION Phase 1試験（NCT06460844）はオープンラベル用量漸増試験で、RPまたはコロイデレミア患者を対象に最大3つの用量コホートを計画。5年間のフォローアップ。UC Irvineで実施中
recent_updates.source: Company PR (businesswire.com), FDA, glance.eyesoneyecare.com, healio.com, biospace.com

RTx-015.notes: Optogenetic gene therapy delivering a light-sensitive protein via intravitreal injection to reprogram surviving retinal cells. Gene-agnostic approach applicable across 100+ RP-associated genes. ENVISION Phase 1 open-label dose-escalation trial (NCT06460844) at UC Irvine for RP/choroideremia, up to 3 dose cohorts, 5-year follow-up. FDA Fast Track + RMAT designations (dual expedited pathways). If approved, eligible for priority review. Similar approach to MCO-010 (Nanoscope) and ZM-02 (Zhongmou) but distinct protein/vector.

NAC Attack.company: Johns Hopkins University / National Eye Institute
NAC Attack.status: Recruitment goal reached - 485 eligible RP patients at 31 sites; follow-up ongoing

primary_sources.label: Johns Hopkins NAC Attack trial page

recent_updates.event: 組入れ目標到達（485名、31施設、2025年8月末）。対象施設は米国・カナダ・欧州で、日本施設は掲載なし。45ヶ月追跡で、進行データの中間読出しは2028年初頭予定。

NAC Attack.notes: International Phase 3 randomized placebo-controlled trial of oral NAC 1800 mg twice daily. Recruitment goal was reached by the end of August 2025 with 485 eligible RP patients at 31 sites in the United States, Canada, Austria, Germany, the Netherlands, Switzerland, and the United Kingdom; no Japan site is listed. Interim progression readout is expected in early 2028, with final analysis after 45-month follow-up by the end of 2029.

RV-001.target: Gene-agnostic visual restoration (chimeric rhodopsin / GPCR-based optogenetics)

Prime editing in vivo rescue.status: Preclinical mouse proof-of-concept - not a human trial
Prime editing in vivo rescue.registry_note: Preclinical animal study; no NCT or jRCT identifier.
Prime editing in vivo rescue.target: PDE6B Y347X nonsense mutation in rd1 mouse model

recent_updates.event: 将来技術として追加。Nature Communications 2025で、PDE6B Y347Xを持つrd1マウスに対するdual-AAV prime editingが光受容体変性を抑制し視機能悪化を抑えたと報告。ヒト治験ではなく前臨床段階。

Prime editing in vivo rescue.notes: Future-technology item only. Dual-AAV in vivo prime editing corrected a PDE6B nonsense mutation in rd1 mice, restored PDE6B expression, protected rods, and inhibited vision deterioration versus no treatment. It should not be presented as a near-term clinical option.
